description: About Us page sections, in the order they appear: hero, Our Story (a navy checklist card beside the heading), “What Drive Us” (Vision/Mission/Values on a navy panel), the yellow Brand Promise banner, “Real Credentials, Not Just Claims”, “Who We Serve” (an overlapping-card column beside a photograph, whose last card is always the navy tilted one, by position), “Why Think SME Exists”, “Explore How We Can Help” and the final CTA. The ci_hero_*, ci_grid_{drive,credentials,explore}_* and ci_stack_serve_* field names repeat the other ci-* pages' names, which is what lets template-parts/ci-hero.php, ci-grid.php and ci-stack.php stay page-agnostic. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater; a card whose title is cleared is skipped, and a Values bullet or checklist item whose text is cleared is skipped the same way. Leave a field empty and the design's own copy renders instead: because the theme treats an empty value as “use the design default,” a field that ships with copy cannot be blanked from here, only replaced. Decorative art (the checklist card's icon and background texture, the promise banner's dot-grid texture) is part of the design rather than a field.
